_legend: SOURCED = read off instructions at the quoted address; MEASURED = read off .oracle_park_idle/ram_000600.bin with fable/w/staffdump.py; DERIVED = inferred; UNMEASURED = guess. Money units are pounds*10.

corrections_to_economy_json.hire.fn 0x80085728: is the TRAINING purchase (Staff Information -> employee -> Training). Raises level by 1 (0x8009563C) then charges hireBase[newLevel]*hmult[kind] via 0x80094DC0. Real hiring charges TrySpend(0).
corrections_to_economy_json.wages.type_index_mapping: rec+0x10 is the staff KIND: 0 Mechanic, 1 Entertainer, 2 Cleaner(Handyman), 3 Guard, 4 Researcher (SOURCED: placer switch 0x800DC5A4, message switch 0x800DC5BC, per-pool init kinds 0x80096408=0 0x80095BAC=1 0x800989C4=2 0x80097784=3 0x800998C4=4)

wage_formula.pct: days < monthLen ? floor(100*days/monthLen) : 100; days = McAi+0x10 - P+0x34; monthLen = length of the month just ended (0x80069314)
wage_formula.sum: 0x80086B60 walks pool+8 of all five pools, person = node+8; Money(wage) is x10; rollover 0x80086D70 adds it to BANK+0x12D0 and hist_wages[idx] before TrySpend

hire_offer.path: laptop row 6 Build & Hire (0x80075354) -> Hire -> type -> recruit
hire_offer.type_list_number: remaining hireable = 0x8006A394(mgr,kind)=5 minus pool+0xC (0x80052EA0 case 0xA); 'Guards 5' means 0 employed
hire_offer.monthly_wage: 0x8006A874(rec,-1) = base[rec+0x14] * mult[rec+0x10]; not pro-rated; no person exists yet

staff_information.path: laptop row 5 (0x80074DA8), lists only types with pool+0xC != 0
staff_information.monthly_wage: base[P+0x3C&7]*mult[kind] at current level, not pro-rated

hire_flow.offer_confirm: 0x8007D554 -> 0x800193A4(tool 0x8010972C, state 1, variant=rec+2, kind=rec+0x10); afford check prices the attraction widget, not the recruit

placer_slots.create: 0x8001E508 (kind switch 0x800DC5A4 -> pool creator -> alloc 0x8005D8C8 + init; stamps P+0x34=McAi+0x10)
placer_slots.confirm: 0x8001E720 (0x8004D800 tile check, then commit 0x8001E6BC: ghost off, setState 0, TrySpend(placer+8)=0)

hire_flow.employed_from: creation (X on the offer); simulated from the in-world confirm

recommended.effect: nops the tile-validity branch in the placer confirm 0x8001E720; after X on the offer, one X in the world commits the hire at any tile

pure_data_relink.risk: free-slot persons carry only the class pointer; the AI tick runs their state machine

gating.sandbox_0x80102D34: not read by tick 0x80066C50, rollover 0x80086D70 or wage 0x80094E3C; only needed at 0 to reach Build & Hire (0x80075D74)
gating.free_money_0x801031CC: skips the balance change only; BANK+0x12D0 and hist_wages still accumulate
gating.pause: tick skipped while [0x80103940] != 0 (laptop) or 0x800617D4; placement tool does not pause
gating.rollover_only_caller: 0x80066C50, which is also the calendar's only caller; days advancing implies rollovers ran

falsifiers.definitions: T = McAi+0x10 at rollover, D = P+0x34, ML = month just ended; pct = T-D<ML ? floor(100(T-D)/ML) : 100; BANK+0x12D0 += 10*floor(pct*base[L]*mult/100)

why_the_run_read_zero: X on the recruit card created the staffer on the cursor (count 1); the first triangle ran the placer cancel 0x8001E870 and freed him; four rollovers summed an empty list.
unmeasured: in-world confirm button identity (assumed X, same path as ride placement)
whether the offer's misdirected afford check can fail for staff
behaviour of a staffer committed on an invalid tile
